summary: Redirect rules (a mutation is never sent to another origin; cross-origin GET/HEAD forwards only an allowlist of headers) and request-aware credential redaction (headers, cookies, query, fragment, secret path codes, JSON/multipart bodies, redirect targets, Referer/Link) with a lazy, budgeted mask set that withholds output when it overflows. Redaction keeps the original error class (errors.Is/As to url.Error, net.OpError, DNSError with masked text) so the local-data fallback still works; MCP path parameters are PathEscape-d; doctor, dry-run bodies and local-lookup messages are redacted. Webhook delivery and feedback endpoints are masked in errors and output (client.MaskErrorForURL / MaskURL); the cyclic-safe error identity walk is budgeted. Reprint 637: the two new public paths with a secret path code (/public/screen-share/{code}/state, /webhooks/inbound/forms/{token}) are in sensitivePathParams and their envelopes mask the path. Reprint gocli1219: the hand-written redaction set (maskSet, secretSink, sensitive path and body fields, maskedError identity, MaskURL / MaskPath / MaskErrorForURL) lives in internal/client/redaction_patch.go beside the 4.34.2 client.go; doInternal builds the per-attempt mask set and the dry-run preview masks secret path codes, sensitive query names and body fields; cross-origin redirects carry only the allowlisted headers on top of the 4.34.2 guard (which refuses loopback/private targets and https->http downgrades outright).
reason: Error bodies, error text, URLs and envelopes echo what the server or the redirect chain returns, so credentials sent in headers, bodies, query strings or path codes could reach the terminal, logs or an external redirect target.
validated_outcome: A 308 to another origin for a keyed POST sends nothing; an echoed Authorization, X-API-Key, cookie, password, token array, Location/Referer token or screen-share code never appears in APIError, err.Error(), stderr, dry-run or the JSON envelopes; with more than 256 secrets the output is withheld.
upstream_issue: To file against mvanhorn/cli-printing-press: client-level redirect policy and secret redaction as generator features; path-parameter secrecy as spec metadata (x-secret) so generated envelopes mask it.
